claims.text: Oral urea: safe & effective in several RCTs;
claims.quote: Results from several randomized controlled trials found that oral urea is a safe and effective treatment.

claims.text: ⍉for hypovolemic hyponatremia · drug-related SIADH or AI
claims.quote: Urea should not be used in patients with hypovolemic hyponatremia, drug-related SIADH, or adrenal insufficiency.
